hypotheses.justification: `hdom` is used only to produce the cluster-density hypothesis of `ae_restrict_sourceOpenCube_secondOrderDifferentiableAt_of_clusterDensity`. The library proves the full conclusion from `hn`, `hbounded` and `hconvex` alone: `ae_restrict_sourceOpenCube_secondOrderDifferentiableAt` (ClusterDensity/Final.lean:178) has the same statement without `hfiniteStatement` and without `hdom`. It obtains the cluster density from `SourceCubeSubgradientClusterDensity.of_straszewiczCompactConvex` and `straszewiczCompactConvexStatement`, which is proved for finite-dimensional E in RockafellarCluster/Straszewicz.lean:35. No `sorry` or `axiom` appears in that tree. So without `hdom` the theorem is still true and has the one-line proof `ae_restrict_sourceOpenCube_secondOrderDifferentiableAt hn hbounded hconvex`. That module imports this file, but the statement remains provable. This hypothesis can be removed on its own, or together with `hfiniteStatement`.
